purpose: Shared identity and typing contract for graph, research dossiers, source annotations and subsequent discussion threads.

publication.id_rule: S:{DOI if known, else immutable opaque ID}

relation_types.theory: Theoretical relationship; editor-assigned and non-causal by default
relation_types.enables: One field provides methods or capability relevant to another; review direction before encoding as a directed dependency
relation_types.dependency: Stated methodological dependency; not equivalent to a causal identification claim
relation_types.challenged_by: Research direction is affected by a bottleneck

identity_invariants: Domain IDs A1..G2 are persistent and may not be renamed when display names change
An editorial graph edge is not a causal arrow
Every reviewed relation should reference one or more durable source IDs and review metadata
A field profile does not imply that a specialized pilot dossier is comprehensive
future_migration: Preserve existing data; move content into typed entity records only after schema and route validation.
